title: Remove committed build artifacts (build/) and the accidental 'clear' file from git

evidence.quote: tracked EMPTY database file (+ seed.db.xz binary)
Unicode text with terminal escape sequences — accidentally committed command output

why: Build outputs and a stray terminal-dump are version-controlled at the repo root. They confuse agents scanning the manifest ('is build/seed.db the canonical seed?'), bloat the repo (binary .xz), and signal that .gitignore doesn't cover the root build/ directory.
recommendation: git rm build/ and clear; add root build/ (and *.log at root) to .gitignore; verify tool scripts regenerate seed artifacts under an ignored path.
acceptance_criteria: git ls-files shows no build/ entries and no 'clear' file
